findings.claim: 10-K 列示競爭來源包括既有券商、金融科技、銀行、加密交易所與科技平台，多數對手營運歷史更長、資本更大；部分新興對手受較少監管。
findings.excerpt: Our current and potential future competition principally comes from incumbent brokerages, established financial technology companies, venture-backed financial technology firms, banks, cryptocurrency exchanges, asset management firms, financial institutions, consumer financial service providers and technology platforms.

findings.claim: Q2 2026 Funded Customers 2,840 萬、年增 7%（含 WonderFi 約 30 萬）；管理層自述持續贏得市占，無獨立第三方市占數據。
findings.source: Robinhood Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results（搜尋摘要）

findings.claim: 預測市場領域競爭加劇：Interactive Brokers、Coinbase 等進入，Tenev 預期產業將整併；2026 年已有 10 家向 CFTC 申請 DCM。
findings.source: ingame.com: Robinhood CEO expect consolidation（搜尋摘要）

note: 第三方市占數據未查到；後兩條為搜尋摘要轉述，未核原文。 線索 1 條，程式核實 0 條
